title: List responses truncate into a fixed 8192-byte buffer
evidence: book_api.c:113-115 and 148 build the JSON array into result[8192] via snprintf; a large collection silently truncates and yields malformed JSON
suggestion: Grow the buffer dynamically (realloc) or stream the array to the socket per row

title: Dead filter variable in handle_books GET branch
evidence: book_api.c:111 computes `const char *filter = strstr(path, "?author=")` then discards it with (void)filter; the author filter is actually handled earlier in handle() at line 145
suggestion: Remove the unused variable to reduce confusion

title: Default test target runs only unit tests; integration script not exercised in sandbox

suggestion: None required — reasonable adaptation; requirement of >=3 tests is met (test_coverage=1.0)
